news.headline: Jets elevate Sterling Shepard with Adonai Mitchell in question
news.detail: The Jets promoted veteran Sterling Shepard from the practice squad, as starting WR Adonai Mitchell is questionable with a finger injury, and three other Jets receivers are on injured reserve.

news.headline: Jets' No. 1 TE Mason Taylor (thumb) out vs. high-scoring Lions
news.detail: The Jets will be without No. 1 tight end Mason Taylor (thumb) and safety Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin) when they face the Detroit Lions on Sunday.
